faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Common questions about TrylleKenneth's magical entertainment services
faqPage.bookingQ1: How do I book Kenneth for my event?
faqPage.bookingA1: You can contact Kenneth through the contact form on this website, call at 40 85 27 28, or email kenneth@tryllekenneth.dk. Kenneth performs at corporate events, children's parties and all types of occasions in Copenhagen and throughout Denmark.
faqPage.bookingQ2: How much notice do you need?
faqPage.bookingA2: Ideally 2-3 weeks notice for corporate events and gatherings, but we try to accommodate last-minute bookings when possible. For larger events, more advance notice is recommended.
faqPage.bookingQ3: What types of events can Kenneth perform at?
faqPage.bookingA3: Kenneth can perform at almost any event: children's birthdays, weddings, corporate events, Christmas parties, family celebrations, team building activities, private parties and much more.
faqPage.bookingA4: Kenneth performs throughout Denmark. Based in Copenhagen, he travels to all parts of the country to deliver magical entertainment for your events.
faqPage.pricingA1: Pricing for magical entertainment and corporate events depends on the type of performance, duration, location and number of guests. Contact Kenneth for a custom quote tailored to your specific event.
faqPage.pricingQ2: Are there extra charges for travel or setup?
faqPage.pricingA2: Travel costs may apply depending on location and will be discussed and arranged when you contact us. Setup is normally included in the quote.
faqPage.performanceA1: Performances typically last 30-60 minutes, but can be customized to your preferences. Kenneth can offer both short performances and extended entertainment.
faqPage.performanceQ2: Do you travel outside Copenhagen and Denmark?
faqPage.performanceA2: Kenneth primarily performs in Denmark. For international events, please contact directly to discuss possibilities.
faqPage.performanceQ3: What is the difference between the different types of magic?
faqPage.performanceA3: Children's magic is interactive and lively with lots of participation. Close-up magic is intimate magic performed up close. Stand-up magic is stage performance for larger groups. Wedding magic is elegant and romantic.
faqPage.performanceQ4: Can the audience participate in the magic?
faqPage.performanceA4: Yes, interactive magic where the audience participates is a key part of Kenneth's performances. It creates lasting memories.

corporateEventsPage.eventType4Desc: Entertainment that naturally gets people talking and creates new connections

corporateEventsPage.gallerySubtitle: Photos from successful corporate events in Denmark
corporateEventsPage.testimonial1Text: Kenneth's magical entertainment was the absolute highlight of our annual company party. Guests talked about it all evening and the days after - excellent choice!

corporateEventsPage.faqA1: It depends on your wishes. Typical performances last 30-45 minutes, but can be tailored to your needs - from 15-minute breaks to longer performances.

corporateEventsPage.faqQ3: What if guests have never seen magic before?
corporateEventsPage.faqA3: Perfect! Magic works regardless of experience. Kenneth's classic tricks have been perfected over the years and fascinate all age groups.
corporateEventsPage.faqQ4: Are there extra costs for travel to other parts of Denmark?
corporateEventsPage.faqA4: We're happy to discuss logistics during booking. Kenneth performs throughout Denmark and travel costs are handled individually based on location.

weddingPage.heroTitle: Magical Close-up Magic for Your Wedding
weddingPage.heroSubtitle: Kenneth performs elegant close-up magic at wedding celebrations, creating intimate magical moments between guests - the perfect blend of entertainment and romance.
weddingPage.introText: Your wedding is a day to celebrate love and connection. Close-up magic does just that - it creates moments of wonder and laughter that make guests part of the same magical experience. Naturally, people start talking, smiling, and remember the day as special.
weddingPage.introFeature1: Elegant entertainment without stealing focus from you
weddingPage.introFeature3: Feels natural and romantic - not a stage performance
weddingPage.benefitsTitle: Why Close-up Magic Is Perfect for Your Wedding
weddingPage.benefit1Desc: Close-up magic is performed right in front of guests - each person gets their own personal magical experience, making your day extra special.
weddingPage.benefit2Desc: When people see magic up close and share it together, it creates natural bonds - perfect for introducing people at your wedding.
weddingPage.benefit3Desc: Close-up magic is classic and elegant - it adds refinement without feeling too modern or overdone.
weddingPage.benefit4Desc: From welcome drinks to dessert break - close-up magic can be placed exactly where it fits best in your day's program.
weddingPage.benefit5Desc: Guests remember when the magic happened, who was there, and what they felt - it becomes part of your wedding story.

weddingPage.moment2Desc: Coins that appear from nowhere, disappear and transform in magical ways
weddingPage.moment3Desc: Everyday objects from the wedding become magical entertainment
weddingPage.moment4Desc: Guests become part of the magic - it makes the experience completely personal
weddingPage.placement1Desc: As guests arrive and mingle - magical entertainment that naturally gets people talking
weddingPage.placement2Desc: At the tables during or after the meal - magical entertainment that pauses the meal and creates conversation
weddingPage.placement3Desc: As an elegant finale before the cake or toasts
weddingPage.placement4Desc: During dancing and mingling - magical entertainment that keeps energy high
weddingPage.testimonial1Text: Kenneth's close-up magic was the perfect choice for our wedding. Guests talked about it all evening - it was elegant without being overdone, and exactly what we wanted.
weddingPage.testimonial2Text: We weren't sure what to expect, but Kenneth was incredibly professional. Close-up magic at your table was a completely new experience - so intimate and magical.
weddingPage.testimonial3Text: It was testimony to how elegantly and professionally Kenneth conducted himself all evening. He was clearly experienced with weddings and knew exactly how to keep energy high without stealing focus.
weddingPage.faqTitle: Questions About Close-up Magic at Weddings
weddingPage.faqA1: It completely depends on your wishes and program. Typically Kenneth performs for 1-3 hours and can circulate at tables or be at a specific location. We tailor it to your wedding program.
weddingPage.faqQ2: How do we ensure Kenneth matches our style?
weddingPage.faqA2: We discuss your wedding in detail beforehand - color scheme, theme, tone and your wishes. Kenneth adapts completely to your wedding environment and follows your wishes for when he performs.
weddingPage.faqQ3: What if some guests have never seen magic?
weddingPage.faqA3: Magic works perfectly regardless of experience. There's actually something extra magical about when people see close-up magic up close for the first time.
weddingPage.faqQ4: Is close-up magic appropriate for all wedding styles?
weddingPage.faqA4: Yes, close-up magic is elegant and timeless. From small intimate weddings to large festive events - close-up magic fits all types of weddings.
weddingPage.faqQ5: How much should we plan in advance?
weddingPage.faqA5: We recommend booking at least 1-2 months before the wedding. We discuss timing, placement and all details to ensure close-up magic becomes a natural part of your day.
weddingPage.ctaSubtitle: Contact Kenneth today and add elegance and magic to your wedding celebration program.

birthdayPartiesPage.faqTitle: Questions About Children's Magic Shows for Birthdays
birthdayPartiesPage.faqQ1: How long should the magic show be?
birthdayPartiesPage.faqA1: Typically 45-60 minutes works best for children - it keeps attention and energy high throughout. We adapt completely to your schedule.
birthdayPartiesPage.faqA2: Kenneth can adapt to groups of 5-50 children. The more children the bigger the energy! We adjust the show to the group size.
birthdayPartiesPage.faqQ3: What if there are children of very different ages?
birthdayPartiesPage.faqA3: Kenneth has experience with mixed age groups and adapts the magic so it works for everyone - from toddlers to teenagers.
birthdayPartiesPage.faqQ4: Do we need space for the show?
birthdayPartiesPage.faqA4: A room or garden about 3x4 meters is enough. Kenneth uses very interactive entertainment so a big stage isn't needed.
birthdayPartiesPage.faqQ5: Can Kenneth adapt it to our theme?
birthdayPartiesPage.faqA5: Yes of course! Pirate magic, superhero magic, adventure magic - Kenneth adapts to the theme you want.
birthdayPartiesPage.faqQ6: What if some children are nervous?
birthdayPartiesPage.faqA6: Kenneth is experienced with nervous children. No one is forced and the magic works just as well from the audience seats.
birthdayPartiesPage.familyIntro: Children's magic shows for birthdays are perfect for the whole family - kids love it, adults enjoy it
birthdayPartiesPage.family1Desc: Children are completely delighted - their joy and laughter makes it all worthwhile
birthdayPartiesPage.family2Desc: Even adults are fascinated by the magic and sit enjoying the entertainment
birthdayPartiesPage.family3Desc: A birthday party the whole family talks about for years - it became THE best birthday ever
birthdayPartiesPage.ctaSubtitle: Contact Kenneth today and book professional children's magic entertainment for your next birthday party.
